embodied.title: AIX Future Vision - EGO Data Collection
embodied.hero_subtitle: Egocentric multimodal data collection covering office, factory, home, food processing and other real-world scenarios. Powering embodied AI model training.
embodied.intro_desc: EGO (Egocentric) data is multimodal data collected from a first-person perspective, including visual, depth, audio, IMU and other sensor information. It is the core data source for training embodied AI models, widely used in robotic manipulation, human-computer interaction, autonomous driving and more.
embodied.service_custom_desc: Organize scenarios, personnel and equipment based on client objectives to deliver custom-licensed data collection.
embodied.service_shared_desc: 5,000+ hours of licensed shared data resources covering diverse real-world scenarios, available for filtering and licensing.
embodied.adv_1_desc: 200+ stable team members, 300+ supplier & freelancer pool. 20 people in 3 days, 50 in 7 days, 200 in 15 days. Supports urgent launches and large-scale parallel execution.
embodied.adv_2_desc: 5,000+ hours of licensed shared data, 20,000+ hours of custom project collection experience. Can combine cleaning, annotation and QC into complete delivery packages.
embodied.adv_3_desc: 7-step standardized process: Requirements → Standards → Training → Pilot → Batch → QC → Structured Delivery. Quality is controlled throughout, not just at the end.
embodied.adv_4_desc: Supports mono/stereo EGO collection across office, factory assembly, food processing, home and other real scenarios. Can sync RGB, depth, IMU and other multimodal data.
embodied.adv_5_desc: Deliverables include raw video/image/audio, cleaned data, annotation results, metadata & manifests, QC records, and delivery documentation. Ready to use out of the box.
embodied.video_office_desc: Mono EGO collection, office desktop operation scenario
embodied.video_factory_desc: Mono EGO collection, factory assembly line operations
embodied.video_food_desc: Mono EGO collection, food factory sorting & packaging
embodied.video_home_desc: Stereo EGO collection, daily activities in home environment
embodied.video_hotglue_desc: Stereo EGO collection, precision manual operation scenario
embodied.process_subtitle: Quality is not about picking data at the end, but full-process control from standard setting, personnel training to process sampling.
embodied.contact_desc: Have EGO data collection needs? Reach out via WeChat for a customized solution.
